brands.name: Limestone Springs
brands.intro: Familiar waters, sodas and mixers with Kentucky roots and an everyday place in shops around the world.
story: Limestone Springs was founded in Frankfort, Kentucky, in 2002. Its full beverage range launched in 2015, building a business in waters, sodas and mixers around Kentucky limestone-filtered water.

Part of Hatfield Group within Walker Holdings, Limestone Springs is an established global brand sold in more than ninety countries. Selected waters, mixers and sodas are routinely found in supermarkets, convenience stores, independent neighbourhood shops, hotels, restaurants, cocktail bars and airports.

At Albury, house still and sparkling water, Soda/Club Soda, mixers and bottled soft drinks are Limestone Springs. The producer’s own labels remain part of table and bar service. The available range supports the occasion and the actual order.

Kentucky-source still and sparkling water is bottled at source. Mixers and sodas also use audited regional manufacturing to Limestone specifications, with actual production origin stated on pack. Properly brewed Cream Soda retains its brewing process.

products.name: Still Water
products.description: Served with meals and included in the overnight welcome. Simple, chilled water in the familiar blue-labelled bottle.

products.name: Sparkling Water
products.description: For the table or a long drink, and paired with still water in the welcome basket.

products.name: Cream Soda
products.description: Properly brewed and best enjoyed cold, in its own producer packaging.

brands.more: The full Limestone Springs house range covers Soda/Club Soda; Premium, Light, Elderflower and Aromatic tonics; Ginger Beer and Ginger Ale; Cola, Lemon, Blood Orange, Root Beer, Cream Soda and Bitter Lemon, plus Tonic Syrup. The current chilled selection is confirmed by the team.

brands.name: Hatfield
brands.intro: Kentucky heritage behind globally familiar spirits and wines, with a growing international network of restaurants, hotels and listening clubs.
story: James Hatfield founded the distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, in 1952. Today, master distiller Carolyn Hatfield-Moore oversees the whiskey’s production, quality and maturation.

Hatfield Group belongs to Walker Holdings, with heritage protections preserving the Hatfield name and production standards. Everyday spirits and regional wines reach ordinary shops alongside premium and allocated releases. The hospitality network has 306 operating venues: 240 Bar & Grills, 52 Inns, 12 Stave clubs and two Still Houses, with further signed projects kept separate from the open count.

At Albury, Hatfield’s full commercial spirits and wine families are within the house selection alongside bottles from other producers. Original, Small Batch, Rye, Wheated Bourbon, Bottled in Bond, Single Barrel, longer-aged and allocated bourbon expressions, Hatfield gin, and estate, premium and regional wines can be drawn on; Crispin or Harjit confirms actual cellar stock. The private Alex family barrel is not a bar listing. Hatfield Original also goes into the kitchen’s bourbon–black cherry confiture.

products.name: Hatfield Original
products.description: Four-year Kentucky straight bourbon · 80 proof (40% ABV). The core expression, familiar at the bar and in the kitchen’s preserving repertoire.

products.name: Hatfield Single Barrel
products.description: Eight-year bourbon · 94 proof (47% ABV). Bottled for individual barrel character; a premium step up within the established range.

brands.more: These two pictured bourbons are only examples. Albury’s wider Hatfield range includes Small Batch, Rye, Wheated Bourbon, Bottled in Bond, longer-aged and allocated expressions, Scottish gin, Napa and Chianti Classico estates, premium wines and everyday regional labels. Other producers are served alongside them. Limestone Springs supplies the house water, sodas and mixers.
